parsed.explanation: Exact expansion of the substituted expression: E = (cn−em)² + 2c(x₀−y₀+c−2e)n + 2e(c−x₀+y₀)m + const; (5) is a valid but loose regrouping whose remainder is 2(c−(x₀−y₀))(em−cn) + const, genuinely O(n+m). In Case 1 the text retains only '4c(c−e)qk', and in Case 2 it asserts '4c(c−e)n_k + O(1)'. But from (5) plus |cn_k−em_k|<1 one gets only m_k = (c/e)n_k + O(1), hence an O(n_k) remainder, which can swamp the negative linear term. The needed O(1) bound requires the exact regrouping via em_k−cn_k = O(1); this computation appears nowhere (indeed 4c(c−e) is not even the raw n-coefficient, showing the regrouping was never performed). So the contradictions in Cases 1 and 2 do not follow from what is written; the gap is easily repaired but is not repaired elsewhere in the text.
